intentions.title: Drive the entire bp CLI command tree from the /v1/capabilities manifest, so a new plugin noun/verb appears with zero CLI code change
intentions.evidence: cli.go doc comment: 'Nothing in this package hardcodes a noun, verb, or route... dispatch fills the per-command http.path_template via manifest.BuildURL'; load.go's loadManifest resolves the manifest via --manifest/$BARKPARK_MANIFEST/ETag-cached GET /v1/capabilities; run.go's buildManifestRequest pipeline (splitArgs→bindArgs→BuildURL→applyQuery→buildBody→authHeaders) is fully manifest-generic.

intentions.title: Give the TUI and the headless MCP server the exact same request-build/send pipeline as the interactive CLI, so no surface can drift in what a command actually does
intentions.evidence: run.go separates buildManifestRequest/sendManifestRequest/execManifestCommand (headless, no rendering) from runCommand (adds --dry-run, prod write-guard, --all pagination, rendering); mcp_serve.go: 'runMCPServe... reuses the CLI's manifest-driven request machinery... so the tools can never drift from what `bp task …` does.'

intentions.title: Guarantee stable, documented exit codes (0-8) mapped from the server's canonical error envelope, never re-derived from HTTP status, so scripts/agents can branch reliably on failure class
intentions.evidence: errors.go: codeExit map and doc comment 'the CLI keys on the envelope's `code` string and NEVER re-derives an exit code from the HTTP status'; exit constants documented against docs/cli/error-exit-table.md; special-cased 'halted' and task-conflict codes (fenced_off, stale_claim, rev_mismatch) mapped to exit 6.

intentions.title: Make bp a full native control plane for Hetzner Cloud (servers, networking, storage, backups) without requiring the hcloud binary
intentions.evidence: hetzner_cmd.go header comment describing the full command tree (server/ssh-key/volume/network/firewall/load-balancer/dns/storage/backup); hetzner_dns_cmd.go, hetzner_lb_cmd.go, hetzner_net_cmd.go, hetzner_storage_cmd.go, hetzner_backup_cmd.go, hetzner_resources_cmd.go as sibling verb files; token resolution via --token/HCLOUD_TOKEN/hcloud context; every mutating verb waits Action.WaitFor to completion.

intentions.title: Let bp be the CLI onramp into Barkpark Cloud: authenticate, provision, and manage a fleet of hosted Barkparks from one binary
intentions.evidence: cloud12_cmd.go: bp login/signup/logout, bp barkparks (authoritative fleet from registry), bp provider add, bp launch, bp go-live, all via internal/cloudclient; cloud_instance_*.go (archive/lifecycle/resurrect/top), cloud_status_cmd.go, cloud_usage.go, cloud_webhook_cmd.go, cloud_members.go, cloud_domain_cmd.go round out fleet lifecycle management.

intentions.title: Prove a Barkpark deployment is actually healthy end-to-end via one command (bp doctor), including auth, TLS, websocket, and Postgres reachability
intentions.evidence: doctor_cmd.go: 'runs the 7-check health gate... covering the full readiness battery (the websocket-not-403 footgun, TLS, Postgres-via-API)'; honest not-ready reporting for unimplemented stub probes rather than fake green; opt-in cloud-sites probe when a Cloud token is present.

intentions.title: Turn agentic coding sessions (cmux panes, Claude Code hooks) into first-class Barkpark task-queue workers that claim, renew, and close tasks automatically
intentions.evidence: cmux_cmd.go/cmux_hook.go/cmux_dispatch.go/cmux_install.go: 'a cmux pane that IS a Barkpark worker — claim its task on SessionStart, renew the lease while working, close on proven acceptance'; hook path is fail-safe (always exits 0, 'a hook must never break the agent'); tasks_frontier_cmd.go computes the maximal parallel-safe task set client-side from the same taskboard.Frontier model the TUI uses.

intentions.title: Expose Barkpark Tasks (and optionally the full manifest) as MCP tools over stdio for any MCP-native client (Cursor, Claude Desktop, etc.)
intentions.evidence: mcp_serve.go: 'bp mcp serve' stdio JSON-RPC server; fail-fast manifest load ('a ready server on the pipe... must die immediately'); strict invariant that tool handlers write nothing to stdout to avoid corrupting the protocol stream; mcp_bridge.go/mcp_resources.go/mcp_tasks.go implement the tool surface.

intentions.title: Uphold a stable, self-describing usage/help and output-format contract (table/JSON/YAML/minimal) across every command so scripting and human use share one CLI
intentions.evidence: output.go 'CLI output renderer (table/JSON/YAML/minimal)', table.go 'CLI table renderer for API payloads', usage.go 'CLI usage/help text renderer', globals.go 'CLI global flags parser' — all generic, cmd-shape-agnostic renderers consumed uniformly by manifest and built-in commands alike.
